reviews.review_description: Great products used, simple straight forward quote and installation was fairly seamless. Would recommend the DSES team to others contemplating solar.

Took a while to get started but then all went smoothly.Very polite trades people, very efficient and left the site clean and tidy.Took me through the system and got the app so I can view the system performance  all set up for me.I've been very happy with the system performance.Energy company has swapped out my meter which was all organised for me by DSES.
Everything went very well until brief handover on the day. Since then unable to contact them to assist with system

I found Daniel Shea to be very professional, skilled and experienced in his work.  Daniel was prompt with his quoting and with my install.  Daniel's customer service is excellent, very polite and helpful.  He also organised the grid connection and government rebate making the entire experience very easy for me.

Of three great quotes, it came down to price and local company. Daniel designed a system that met our needs brilliantly. The installation crew were very polite and highly competent. Brandon explained the operation of the system and how to shut down if necessary. Communication with the office was great and hassle free. All documentation was provided online. Very happy with the whole process.
Very satisfied with the work done in the given time frame. Punctual. Good communication throughout the whole process. Thank you for a great job?
A pleasure to deal with, everything completed to plan and to a high standardThanks Daniel and team

Sales, Installation & Customer service can not be faulted. Everything was done on time with the site left clean and all paperwork submitted to the relevant authorities.  Overall very happy with the process.

Daniel did the quoting and was good to work with and was punctual and reliable.Whoever did the invoicing was prompt and organised.The installation took place a lot sooner than I expected.The person who managed the installation on the day was polite and good to work with.They organised the changes required with my ERGON contract.The only thing that was disappointing was that I had to clean up the work area after the installation.

I contacted Daniel as he was recommended by another person. Right from the start he was down to earth and everything  was done for me. The installation was in place within  week and his Team was great. Couldn't ask for anything bettter.

Daniel Shea Electrical was the quickest to respond, and the cheapest quote for the same products. Both Daniel and his installation staff were friendly and prompt with the installation.Daniel Shea Electrical handled all aspects of the installation including liaising with Ergon Energy for the grid connection.I would definitely recommend Daniel Shea Electrical to anyone that wants to install solar.
Most aspects of the purchase and installation went well, a smooth operation.
The company has been around for a few years. Local family and use quality products.Very pleasant to deal with.

We received 5 quotes including DSES. DSES were one of the only quotes to include a plan of putting solar panels on the west facing roof as well as the north. As our north facing roof did not have enough space for a 6.6 kW system the use of the west facing roof provides good energy output all day.While DSES were a bit slow to get moving (understandable I suppose with the workload) they did everything very well. I was very happy with the crew who installed the equipment, they were professional and courteous. They left with everything cleaned up and working well. I was taken through the system thoroughly and they set the app up for me and it's easy to use.They have organised everything with Ergon Energy (the only provider here) and all is working well.
Highly recommended DSES. Fantastic service, before,during and after installation and best price.

After I dove into the rabbit hole that is Solar providers. DSES were the fourth provider I had spoken to.Daniel was so clear and concise. Everything provided was exactly what I needed and for a great price. He made all the adjustments, added a timer to my hot water system and has handled all the paperwork and registration.I would highly recommend DSES as a first point of contact.Extremely trustworthy, fast service and clean, high quality installation.
Prompt and Efficient with quote and installation.Daniel and his team are fantastic.
Great service, I can see why they have got so many great reviews.

We wanted a bit more than panels.-3Phase Upgrade-Board Clean Up (Dated breakers/No RCBOs)-10Kw Solar-E/W Configuration-Backup/Battery Ready.DSES did everything from the Ergon work requests/trenching to final installation and commissioning of Solar. Everything was installed cleanly and without fault or concern. I can see why they're busy!Would gladly recommend
Prompt delivery, good quality system with good product warranty and good customer service

I have no hesitations in recommending Daniel Shea Electrical and Solar. From start to finish it has been an easy and pleasant experience. The quote came through with an overview of the panel layout, a number of options for panel and inverter brands plus spec sheets for those products. I was really pleased when Daniel came out to meet me and check the inverter location. I was also able to choose the day of install to fit in with my schedule. Not only did the team that arrived on the day do a fantastic job, they were friendly, well mannered and put up with all my questions. The panel and inverter install looks great and they even replaced a broken tile they found that wasn’t where they were working. I was shown how to set up the monitoring app on my phone and taken through the shutdown/startup procedure for the system on completion. The very next day I received a heap of supporting documentation for the system from Angie in admin, who also sorted out registering the warranty for the inverter. The system has been performing great since and I have just received my 40 page personalised user manual, containing everything I need to know from how the individual components work together, to install testing details. A quality document from a top notch company.Thanks DSES!
Seen about solar one day, the quote arrived next day installation few week later, installers were polite didn't take long, left place tidy good experience, would recommend.
Daniel Shea was very professional. The solar was installed in two weeks and the customer service was excellent.

Daniel was first installer to visit our site and answered all our questions personally.Then promptly provided us with multiple detailed quotes for different sized and value systems.After choosing one of his quotes he organised our installation quite quickly. His staff were very efficient and polite and cleaned up after themselves when finished on the second day. They organised all paperwork online including contacting Ergon to finish the grid connection and we are now happily living with our solar system.

Everything from the initial contact to enquire about a Solar installation to the completion of the job was excellent.  It was less than two weeks from our initial enquiry to full installation.  We found all personnel to be friendly, professional and took pride in the job they were undertaking and cleaned up after the job. They also submitted all the necessary forms to Ergon and arranged the grid connection.The guys turned up on time and when they said they would and kept us informed at all times including a full run down on the system once it was switched on.I'd have no hesitation in recommending Daniel Shea Electrical and Solar.
Very professional.Very impressed with the installation. One of the best installs I have seen.

The Installation of Solar Power to our home was very efficient. From first contact by phone to inquire, an appointment in our home with the owner of the business with lots of information and a very professional team to install our system. We got what we paid for on the day, on time and without fuss.  Thanks Daniel and the team.
Brilliant customer service, all connected and ready for connection to grid on same day, wonderful to deal with and great follow up service

Quoting was friendly but to the point.  No wasted time, no hard sell and very honest.Installation was done on time, as arranged by competent friendly and safe hard workers.The grid connection was organised and happened when expected.Personal run through how to use the controls was straight forward and thorough. All manuals supplied.

Sales and Quoting process was only somewhat helpful.Installation went late in day and was rushed at the end with very minimal explanation of app and connection.Meter board upgrade was poorly done and had to have rework done for ergon meter to be fitted some 6 weeks later.After receiving my first bill i wanted to get clarity of power consumption on the bill for the period and better understanding of app usage with them.My phone calls to his message bank and text messages have gone unanswered.
Great service. Professional, prompt and efficient. The solar installation company were fantastic.

Everything went well, except now I have seen your video solar 101 and i have a concern over where the inverter is as it catches the sun in the afternoon during summer, so considering doing something about that.
Highly recommend Daniel and the team at DSES. A friendly conversation, competitive pricing and punctual. He organised all the grid connection and made the whole process easy.
No fuss quote and quick installation.Nearly half the price of other quotes

I found DSES to be a very professional team. Prompt quoting, very informative, quality products and workmanship!Administration work was excellent- all of the applications, including grid connection, was taken care of.Highly recommend this installer!

Daniel called me, we had a no-nonsense conversation and the quote arrived quickly. I made some changes to increase the size of the system which was sent through prompty. After signing off on the quote installation proceeded quickly and without drama. All rubbish was taken away and everything left neat and tidy. Would recommend.

Great price for my 10.14 kW system  26 x 390Watt panels married to 8.2kW Fronius Inverter.This system is providing 40 x70 kWh per day varies with cloud coverLooking forward to very low power billsThe panels look sleek in black tinted colour against grey colour bond roofThe installation quality was extremely high I’m an Electrical Engineer and very fussy I have many contractorsWork for my in industry and I know what good looks like not just superficialI would highly recommend this company to anyone
Very professional organization High quality staff & workmanship installation in a timely manner.

Local and great to deal with and a positive experience from first contact to finished install and was hassle free without unwanted salesman PressureOffers great products to suit your budget requirements

First company to contact me for a quote. Awesome to deal with from quote stage to installation. Very helpful, punctual, knowledgeable, efficient and great workmanship. They took care of all paperwork and applications for installation. I received all warranty certificates, registrations and manual instantly after installation. I was shown how to register for the app so that you can monitor  performance and usage. Highly recommend them.

Daniel turned up promptly at the agreed time,  explained the process to us, and commenced the install with his two contractors.Daniel and his crew did a quality job in a timely fashion, and we are very pleased with the results
got a 3 phase 10kw Fronious inverter and 13.2kw of panels(jinko) very happy with the install and customer service.
Every thing was done to my satisfaction, it's been 6 weeks but I'm still waiting on the power company to fix up there side of things

Quoting was fast and questions answered quickly. Fast and problem free installation. I paid for a meter box upgrade as well as my box was 40 years old. All works completed in a little over 3 hours. Impressed at the speed of the installation.Great team. Good customer service. I received all documentation by email just after installation completed. They organized grid connection. System performing faultlessly. Very happy overall.
Good installation by professional tradesmen and timely work on the day quoted
Daniel was easy to deal with, all ran like clock work and installed within a fortnightWith Daniels assistance we had a Hot water  Timer installed and switchboard up grade
Great to deal with, quality system, good price, quick install, assisted with everything for my application for the solar for rentals trial. Definitely Recommend.
Super helpful the whole way threw the process. Well priced good brands with great warranty. Very happy with the install and will recommend

Daniel is a great salesman - helpful, knowledgeable and friendly. Installation was done on time and quickly, with all paperwork for the energy supplier lodged promptly.On the day, Daniel seemed a lot less approachable (perhaps more focused on the job). They wired in the new electric hot water system as discussed. I had asked (at the time he quoted) if they could install the cables for the security cameras through the ceiling space to the eaves of the house. Daniel was prepared to do this. However, on the day, he was not interested in this job. Choosing to leave it till they had completed the solar, meant they could then not remove roof sheeting in the required place to run the cables into the office.This was unfortunate. However, I do like the solar installation - very neat. Canâ€™t wait for the energy supplier to get here to install the new meter (4 weeks from solar installation).I found your website very informative. I had DSES install a Solar Analytics monitor - turned the panels on for a while to check things out, and impressed with the information available.  I have recommended you to numerous people.
Got Daniels name from a neighbour and am glad I used his company. Easy to get a quote, explained it all, gave me exactly what I wanted. Installation was easy and quick. All over a great experience.

â€¢How was the sales/quoting process?.On time, upfront, no pushiness friendly serviceâ€¢How did the installation go? On time, polite, good clean up after jobâ€¢How was the customer service? Customer service great, Ergon connection organised promptly and warranty  registered for us

Solar quotes made it very easy to do product research on the different systems that I was quoted on. Daniel Shea offered their best price for a quality system and was very down to earth, easy to talk to which made the overall experience a good one. Staff were efficient and took time to clean up and look after property. Would highly recommend.

Good system installed with the inverter installed in the garage instead of at the power box which was harder but keeps it out of the weather and done with no extra charge. System was installed 2 weeks after first contact. Top quality switches and wiring used. Wifi monitoring all set up. Answered all phone calls and emails quickly with correct information.

The sales and quoting process was very easy and the installation happened very quickly.  The installation job was clean, tidy and very prompt.  I have found the post sales customer service to be lacking.

The quoting process was simple yet detailed, with a variety of budget-minded options presented. Extremely fast response from time of quote to installation, and absolutely no hassles with either. I wasn't present for the install, however the place was left tidy, and the end result extremely pleasing....just waiting to see the pay-off with the electricity bill. I was originally quoted by five companies, three of which were walk-ins, and Daniel's price was more than competitive, beating two of the quotes by a couple of thousand dollars each. I'm glad I've gone local, as I know the support will be there in a timely fashion if anything goes wrong. Excellent job all round and completely hassle-free.

Daniel was prompt in contacting me, he answered all questions honestly and was very knowledgeable about solar, he was great to deal with. His workers were excellent at their job. The end product looks good and works well, plus they were also great to deal with and bent over backwards to help even installing a new heating element on my Hot water system without even being asked. I couldn't recommend these guys enough.Thanks
Easy to deal with. Did everything for me all I had to do was transfer money
All involved were polite helpful and informative. Installation was quick with no mess left behind and Daniel sorted all of the grid connection process. Highly recommend them.
one of other quotes did seem more interested in selling the more expensive brand of everything and not really giving the options so that was an straight failure and rejected.

Daniel offered good realistic advice above what I had expected of him. His workers were prompt and polite and left my yard in a neat and tidy state at the end of the job. I was given advice about what to expect from Ergon. These guys are overall a professional and trustworthy group; it is well worth dealing with Daniel Shea.
DSSE was the only local installer that quoted so was happy to give them a shot on principle, very happy with service and installation.
Preferred to deal with the actual hands-on installer - not with a (commission?) salesman.
The first supplier to get in contact with us, excellent customer service and great to deal with. Positive comunication throughout whole ordeal.

I was really keen to take advantage of the solar for rentals initiative in Gladstone and Dan was the only person who was willing to take the time to answer every one of my questions without dismissing them as irrelevant, he was also the only person to advise me on the benefit of adding extra panels. He also knows about the Solar For Rentals scheme and what was needed to make our claim process hassle free. Installation was fast and Dan and his team were very professional, they respected the property (even putting cardboard between their ladder and the new guttering so as to not scratch it) and cleaning up after themselves. Dan is a Gladstone local so if there are any issues in the future I have peace of mind that he is close by to help sort them out.

The quoting process was quick. Daniel was easy to talk to and answered all of our questions. Once we decided to go with DSES the installation was carried out fast and done in a day. Every thing was left tidy all the workers were friendly and polite. Highly recommend this solar company to anyone.
No complaints from me, Dan and his crew did a great job, highly recommended for anyone wanting solar installed in the Gladstone area,thanks for the recommendation Finn

All went smoothly, well organised, and we would recommend to others.  Daniel and his team were on the ball with installation, and liaison with Ergon was timely and efficient, Matt has already been on the phone following up whether we are satisfied with everything - good service.

We went with Daniel Shea Electrical for two reasons.1. He had very good reviews and most were very positive.2. More bang for our buck. He was the same price as some others but with two extra panels making it a 6.6 KW system + a hot water timer and they changed the thermostat also to a 1.8w all included in the price.It was a hard choice to make because i found them all very professional to deal with.

From first contact Daniel made the whole process seamless. The team on site were extremely efficient and professional. Could not be happier with our choice of system & installer. Highly recommend Daniel Shea solar & electrical.

The system is good and producing good outputs so I am very happy with it.Decided to go with mid to top range panels and top inverter.Not very much contact from installer, and some problems I had to sort out myself such as correct readings from the relay, and extending the wifi range.Installer didn't meet on site to discuss the installation and the other options which I may have taken up if he had seen the electrical installation which was not a normal single phase dwelling.Other than that, the installation time and workmanship were very good and I am very happy with both.Some follow up from the contractor would be nice.
Great service and timely installation.Not too impressed with the solar app but thatâ€™s not the installers fault.Would recommend Daniel every time.

Dan done a great job, proffessional installation, used top quality hardware & tier 1 panels and we have had no issues with our 5kw system in over 5 yearsAt the time of install price was good in comparison with other quotes, and they installed the inverter in my garage where i requested.
Everything went very quickly and smooth. Good service and cleaned up after themselves

I normally buy on reputation and once engaging DSE&S I was not disappointed.   Dealing with Daniel and his team was a great experience, I am a tradesman (Mechanical Fitter) myself and noted that the work was finished off very well.  Daniel kept me informed every step of the way and ordered the best quality equipment for my system.  I have had conversations with others in my team at work and they have had the same reviews of Daniel and the team.
Very good service and quality work and had the system install in a timely manner would definitely recommend Daniel Shea

Daniel's prompt response to our request for a quotation to supply and install an off-grid system for our island home was a great intro. He offered 2 options and talked us through the differences in the systems which was in simple English and took a lot of our confusion away. The supply was timely and the installation was completed in a day by a hard working team of 4 guys. They literally did not stop all day. By the time the ferry took them back to the mainland the system was fully installed and functional. No problem recommending Daniel Shea and his team: totally professional and extremely knowledgeable about solar systems.
I am really happy that  Daniel and his team did the job. Could not ask for a better result .Highly recommend for all electrical work reliable an efficient.
Iâ€™m very happy with the system. Very professional install of the solar.
Highly recommend, Will use again for future electrical works.
Daniel has done recent electrical work for us since we installed a carport. Neat job all round.

Very prompt in preparing the quote and after me deciding to except it they were very help full in getting it approved with ergon and the installation was prompt and well done I am very happy with all aspects of his work
Great customer service and fast and efficient install. Highly recommend

Daniel and his team were great installers and the back-up service is second to none. Only issue I have is with the ABB inverter playing up although warranty covers it all. I would probably choose a different inverter next time around.
Fast professional installation, Couldn't be happier with the service provided by Daniel and his team.
Very very speedie install. Impressed from start to finish.

The supplier was very efficient and straight to the point, the workmanship is of a high quality and I have always supported the local blokes first, especially when it comesto the after sales customer service.
Very happy with the system design provided, also the component type and quality supplied. No fuss, prompt service.

Great pleasant service from Daniel and his team. They are absolutely great, give excellent advice. I have recommended their service to other people.Always on time and nothing is too much trouble and have utilised Daniel and his team for other work on the property
Found Daniel and his staff very professional and excellent service provided, will have no hesitation in recommending him for future work
Super quick install and pleasure to do business with.
Great no hassle installed quickly and a local contractor
A bit lacking in followup. I called a couple of times with queries, but did not get a response. Nevertheless, the installation was excellent, very tidy and neat.
On/Off grid system. Lg 9.8kw batt, sun grow inverter, 6.4 phono onyx panels.
Daniel was very helpful with advice and very quick with approvals and installation

Daniel and his team are an efficient group of professionals!  DSES provide a competitive quote and a world class installation.   Not only do they install solar, I also had AC installed and other general electric work.  Couldn't ask for a better experience.  I will recommend them to anyone that I speak with.    Thanks again.

We have been in contact with this installer a few times & they have been over & above to answer any questions we have hadWe are recommending them to anyone we know & we will be giving them more business because of their professionalism & know how to get a job done with back up service when you need it as we were not very clewed up with this until Daniel Shea Electrical did that for us.Thanks guysAlbert & Sharyn

Only received the one call and quote but came recommended by people at work and was happy with price. Better than what I expected looking at prices online and quotes from other companies that friends had received

Daniel and his staff were very efficient and prompt with their quotation and installation. After installation he gave me a tutorial on how to monotor the system and explained what each symbol and read out meant. he also explained the procedures for warranty if required.
Prompt and efficient service/installation.
DSES Pty Ltd were very efficient installers.I was impressed with their business management.
